page.overview:
Who is Kassien?

Kassien was a female Rattataki Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic. A merchant, she sold armor to Sith Inquisitors on Vaiken Spacedock.

Lord Kassien appears in the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic, released by BioWare in 2011, as a PvP Warzone Gear Vendor for the Sith Inquisitor class on Vaiken Spacedock. She came back in Game Update 5.1 as a Tier 2 Inquisitor Unassembled Tokens vendor.
